UseCurrency.Name: Show Currency
UseCurrency.Hint: Whether or not to show your currency within the inventory.

UseEncumbrance.Name: Show Encumbrance
UseEncumbrance.Hint: Whether or not to show the encumbrance indicator.

UseContainer.Name: Use Containers
UseContainer.Hint: (Patreon Feature) Whether or not to use the containers.

AdditionalItemInfo.Name: Add additional info
AdditionalItemInfo.Hint: Adds additional information to items and spells regarding actions, rolls and average damage.

ShowAverageDamage.Name: Show average Damage
ShowAverageDamage.Hint: Additionally displays average damage in quick info

ShowBioTab.Name: Show Tab 'Biography'
ShowBioTab.Hint: Shows the biography tab of a character

AllowBioEdit.Name: Editable biography
AllowBioEdit.Hint: Enables the edit function for biography. Warning: Once you enter the editor, there is no way (if you don't have an ESC key) to cancel any changes you made.

notInCombat.title: Not in Combat!
notInCombat.text: You are not in combat. The DM has to add you to the combat tracker first. Re-open this dialog after being added to the tracker.
